description.value: The Hive is a multi-location indoor climbing gym chain with a North Shore outpost in North Vancouver's Dollarton area. It offers bouldering and climbing in a purpose-built sports facility, making it a potential activity stop for touring cyclists exploring the North Shore. Visitors must sign a waiver on their first visit, and youth require parental consent and adequate adult supervision.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 7m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is largely repetitive waiver-wizard boilerplate across all subpages, with the dedicated amenities/accessibility page rendering nearly empty ('Hive New_production' only). The North Shore address (140 - 2270 Dollarton Hwy, North Vancouver, V7H 1A8) is confirmed on the website, matching OSM exactly. No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, showers, water, etc.) are surfaced in the scraped content, so nearly all amenity fields must be null per evidence rules.

All other subpages were dominated by repetitive waiver-wizard UI text, obscuring any facility-specific amenity or contact information.

OSM 'name' tag is 'The Hive' while 'name:en' is 'The Hive North Shore'; the website uses both interchangeably — minor naming inconsistency worth noting if the directory needs a unique per-location name.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Hive North Shore is a legitimate attraction for touring cyclists, but the scraped website content consisted almost entirely of waiver-wizard boilerplate; the amenities/accessibility page rendered empty. None of the required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed, so a manual check of the facility is needed before including it in the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: A direct visit or call would quickly resolve the required criteria. As a climbing gym, showers and washrooms are highly probable but cannot be asserted without evidence.

wow_evidence: Climbing gym with day access — climbing-gym ladder 1/2; waiver is normal, KW false positive.
